items.title: Singapore's Temasek to expand Middle East presence, open Abu Dhabi, Riyadh offices
items.summary: Singaporean state-owned investor Temasek plans to open offices in Abu Dhabi and Riyadh, expanding its Middle East footprint as the region attracts capital despite the strain of the Iran war.

items.title: Beijing warns of retaliation if Europe imposes curbs on Chinese businesses
items.summary: BEIJING — China's commerce ministry has sent a strong warning to the European Union ahead of expected high-level talks in Beijing next week.

items.title: Goldman Sachs CEO succession planning faces one big problem

items.title: Polymarket taps Goldman Sachs veteran Lisa Mantil to attract Wall Street liquidity
items.summary: Prediction market exchange Polymarket has hired a near three-decade Goldman Sachs veteran to help lead its push to attract Wall Street liquidity.

items.title: Trump’s municipal bond portfolio reaches as much as $1 billion as policy overlaps mount
items.summary: President Donald Trump is a creditor to hundreds of cities, hospitals, schools, utilities and other public institutions across the country — many of which are directly affected by decisions made by his own administration.

items.title: China has three new criteria for humanoid robot IPOs. Few, if any, meet them
